title: Successor and maximum space bounds
statement: For every function $s : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the class of binary languages decidable with space bounded by a constant multiple of $s(n)+1$ equals the class decidable with space bounded by a constant multiple of $\max(1,s(n))$.
